ios.desc:
Hi there from Xantos! 

We are an investment manager for the next generation of investors. As an SEC-registered adviser, we build and manage investment portfolios for everyday folks. 

Our mission is to offer a low minimum, low fee, and premium investing experience so anyone can invest like a pro without having to learn finance jargon! We strive for exceptional risk-adjusted returns. We are fully transparent and pragmatic in educating our clients about how and what we invest.

- Premium experience: We don’t just manage your investments, we explain it all and always serve in your best interest!

- Easy to use: Quickly onboard and set up an account in under 5 mins from your couch.

- Simple fees: $0 performance fees. Fees are charged monthly and deducted from your account - never worry about overdraft fees with us.

- SIPC protection: Our custodian is a member of FINRA/SIPC. Securities in your account are protected up to $500,000. Learn more at www.sipc.org.

- No lock-in: Life happens. Cancel and close your account anytime.

Disclosures:  Investment Advisory Services are offered through Xantos Labs LLC (“Xantos”), an SEC-registered investment advisor. Brokerage and custodial services are offered through Alpaca Securities LLC, a FINRA/SIPC member.

Nothing in this communication or the application (the “App”) should be construed as tax advice, a solicitation or offer, or recommendation, to buy or sell any security in any jurisdiction where such an offer, solicitation, or recommendation would be unlawful or unauthorized. 


To open an account, you must be at least 18 years of age. Links provided to other server sites are offered as a matter of convenience and are not intended to imply that Xantos Labs or its affiliates endorses, sponsors, promotes, and/or is affiliated with the owners of or participants in those sites, or endorses any information contained on those sites unless expressly stated otherwise.

All investing involves risk, including possible loss of money you invest, and past performance does not guarantee future performance. Before taking action, please see our Brochure and Full Disclosures for important details.

© 2026 Xantos Labs LLC. All rights reserved.

quotes.text:
Xantos Labs was born out of frustration for the lack of premium investment advice for the next generation of investors who didn’t have premium sized checking accounts. While building our investment platform, we noticed two things: that top level investing advice wasn’t available to folks like us, and that there were, in fact, novel approaches to managing a portfolio rather than just sticking our money in over-diversified ETFs that simply follow the overall benchmark.

Our mission is to offer a premium investing experience to everyone and our platform is built with everyday folks in mind. As an SEC-registered adviser, we thoroughly research the best companies so you don't have to! And we build and manage a concentrated portfolio of high conviction picks using an investment process focused on managing downside risks.

Available in the App Store & Google Play!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xantos-labs/id1571651655
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xantoslabs
